title: Getting started with datapond
Getting started with datapond
text: dp_connect() returns ordinary DuckDB DBIConnection: Every database ships data dictionary; dp_describe() reads : dbplyr works unchanged:
code: con <- dp_connect("eoir") DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM proceedings LIMIT 5") dp_describe(con)                         # tables dp_describe(con, table = "proceedings")  # columns, types, null %, join hints dp_describe(con, search = "judge")       # columns by name library(dplyr) tbl(con, "proceedings") |>   count(DEC_CODE, sort = TRUE) |>   head(10) |>   collect() dp_disconnect(con)

title: Getting started with datapond
text: Pass vector ids. Tables qualified database id, ids contain hyphen must double-quoted SQL:
code: con <- dp_connect(c("cms-medicare", "openpayments")) DBI::dbGetQuery(con, 'SELECT * FROM "cms-medicare".physician_summary LIMIT 5') tbl(con, I('"openpayments".main.general_payments')) |> head(5) |> collect() dp_disconnect(con)

title: Query Curated DuckDB Databases Built from Public Data
Query Curated DuckDB Databases Built from Public Data
text: connection plain duckdb_connection, DBI dbplyr work usual:
code: library(datapond)  dp_list()                 # database ids dp_info("eoir")           # size, source, coverage, links  con <- dp_connect("eoir") # attaches remotely; nothing is downloaded in full DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM proceedings LIMIT 5")  dp_describe(con)                         # tables with row counts dp_describe(con, table = "proceedings")  # columns, types, null %, join hints dp_describe(con, search = "judge")       # find columns by name  dp_disconnect(con) library(dplyr) con <- dp_connect("eoir") tbl(con, "proceedings") |> count(DEC_CODE, sort = TRUE) |> head(10) |> collect()

title: datapond 0.1.1
text: Real downloads work : response headers curl returns vector lines, one string, resumed transfer’s Content-Length remaining range (total comes Content-Range). server answers stale -Range whole file makes curl abort resume; client now discards partial file restarts. paths covered real loopback HTTP server test (httpuv + callr, Suggests). dp_download() streams <file>.part, resumes remote file revision (strong validator, ETag else Last-Modified, recorded beside partial file; ranged request bound -Range GET response’s validator checked, file changes HEAD GET re-downloaded scratch; validator, resume), validates finished file DuckDB database, rejects directory destination, errors instead warning destination replaced. existing local copy never damaged failed download. dp_update() compares remote file’s ETag (else Last-Modified) identity recorded download time (<file>.datapond.json) instead file’s modification time; equal sizes alone never count current; registry re-fetched first. registry response decoded UTF-8 explicitly, package works C/ASCII locale; unparseable response falls back cached copy. dp_download(path = "/dir/") creates directory.
